shellCommands.command: npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
ls .next/server/app/ && grep -l "Compact Widget" .next/server/app/product* 2>/dev/null; grep -c "Compact Widget" .next/server/app/product.html 2>/dev/null || echo "not in product.html"
grep -o "Compact Widget" .next/server/app/product.segments | head -3; echo "---segments exit: $?"; ls .next/server/app/product/ 2>/dev/null; grep -c "Compact Widget" .next/server/app/product.segments

head -c 600 .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc; echo; echo "=== _tree:"; head -c 600 .next/server/app/product.segments/_tree.segment.rsc; echo; echo "=== _full:"; head -c 400 .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc

python3 -c "
data = open('.next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc').read()
i = data.find('Compact Widget')
print('context in __PAGE__:', repr(data[max(0,i-200):i+100]))
print()
full = open('.next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc').read()
j = full.find('Compact Widget')
print('context in _full:', repr(full[max(0,j-200):j+100]))
"

grep -rn "prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | grep -v ".map" | head -20; echo ===; grep -rn "prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/app-segment-config.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

grep -n "PrefetchHint" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-types.d.ts; echo ===; grep -rn "PrefetchHint\." node_modules/next/dist/build/ node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".map" | head -20

find node_modules/next/dist -name "app-router-types.*" | head; grep -rn "SubtreeHasRuntimePrefetch\|HasRuntimePrefetch\|RuntimePrefetch" node_modules/next/dist/shared/ node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-types.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".map" | head

grep -rn "prefetch={true}\|prefetch={true}" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/*.js node_modules/next/dist/client/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".map" | grep -i "warn\|deprecat\|instead" | head; grep -rln "SubtreeHasInstantFalse" node_modules/next/dist/client/ | grep -v ".map"

grep -rn -B3 -A20 "createLinkPrefetchPartialError" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/errors/*.js node_modules/next/dist/client/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".map" | head -50; grep -rln "createLinkPrefetchPartialError" node_modules/next/dist/ | grep -v ".map" | grep -v compiled
grep -n "connection" node_modules/next/dist/api/server.js | head -5; grep -rn "export.*connection" node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3

grep -c "Compact Widget" .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc; grep -o "Loading related products" .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc | head -1; echo ===; grep -c "Compact Widget" .next/server/app/product.html

npx next start -p 3100 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3100/

echo "--- default segment prefetch (page shell):"; curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_tree" http://localhost:3100/product | head -c 300; echo; echo "--- full prefetch (prefetch={true}):"; curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3100/product | grep -c "Compact Widget"

echo "=== full prefetch:"; curl -s -D - -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3100/product -o /tmp/full-prefetch.txt | head -15; wc -c /tmp/full-prefetch.txt; head -c 500 /tmp/full-prefetch.txt; echo; echo "=== segment prefetch _tree:"; curl -s -D - -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_tree" http://localhost:3100/product -o /tmp/tree.txt | head -12; wc -c /tmp/tree.txt; cat /tmp/tree.txt

echo "=== full prefetch (prefetch={true}):"; curl -sL -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3100/product -o /tmp/full.txt; grep -c "Compact Widget" /tmp/full.txt; grep -c "Loading related products" /tmp/full.txt; echo "=== page segment prefetch (default shell):"; curl -sL -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /product/__PAGE__" http://localhost:3100/product -o /tmp/seg.txt; wc -c /tmp/seg.txt; grep -c "Compact Widget" /tmp/seg.txt; grep -c "Loading related products" /tmp/seg.txt

wc -c /tmp/full.txt; head -c 800 /tmp/full.txt; echo; echo "=== retry full prefetch following redirect manually:"; loc=$(curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3100/product | grep -i location | tr -d '\r' | cut -d' ' -f2); echo "redirect: $loc"; curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100$loc" -o /tmp/full2.txt; wc -c /tmp/full2.txt; grep -c "Compact Widget" /tmp/full2.txt

echo "=== RSC navigation request (no prefetch header):"; curl -s -H "RSC: 1" http://localhost:3100/product -o /tmp/nav.txt; grep -c "Compact Widget" /tmp/nav.txt; grep -c "Loading related products" /tmp/nav.txt; echo "=== HTML document request:"; curl -s http://localhost:3100/product -o /tmp/doc.html; grep -c "Compact Widget" /tmp/doc.html; grep -c "Loading related products" /tmp/doc.html
curl -s -H "RSC: 1" "http://localhost:3100/product?_rsc" -o /tmp/nav3.txt; wc -c /tmp/nav3.txt; grep -c "Compact Widget" /tmp/nav3.txt; grep -c "Loading related products" /tmp/nav3.txt
